R384.note: Allowlist on field with ValueError before query build; tenant_id and term remain bound params; matches contract.

R385.note: resolve_entities=False is the correct lxml XXE fix, directly reversing the demonstrated vulnerable flag; no behavior change for legitimate XML.

R386.note: signedJWT.getHeader().getAlgorithm() returns JWSAlgorithm, not String, so `String algorithm = ...getAlgorithm();` fails to compile - confirmed by compiling against nimbus-jose-jwt 9.37.3 in a scratch dir; the fix, and the whole class, would never build, silently breaking the endpoint entirely.

R387.note: Replaces PowerShell invocation with the native Ping API, eliminating process execution entirely (the CWE-78 primary defense); rewrite to an equivalent connectivity check is stated openly and does not block legitimate use.

R388.note: Extension now derived from detected.ext (matched against the already-validated MIME type) instead of the client-supplied name; correct primary defense, no behavior change for allowed types.

R389.note: Rejects CR/LF in reply-to/recipient/subject before any SMTP bytes are written; legitimate single-line email addresses and subjects are unaffected.

R390.note: Parameterized query via SqlParameter; apostrophes in actor are now treated as literal data exactly per the stated contract.

R391.note: UUID filename with MIME-derived extension closes the path traversal/dangerous-extension vector; success/failure response shapes (url on 200, json error on 400) are preserved per contract.

R392.note: app.UseAntiforgery() alone does not validate this endpoint: minimal-API endpoints bound from a JSON body need explicit RequireAntiforgeryToken metadata (missing here), which was confirmed by compiling and running a reproduction where a POST with no antiforgery token still returned 202 Accepted after the fix was applied. The change is otherwise inert, so no other behavior is altered.

R393.note: Magic-byte check against the declared content type runs before the copy; reading MultipartFile.getInputStream() twice is standard/supported; no legitimate PNG/JPEG is rejected.

R394.note: Adds Secure:true to the session cookie, the standard fix for CWE-614, with no other observable change.

R395.note: SimpleEvaluationContext.forReadOnlyDataBinding() blocks method invocation, type references, and constructors while still supporting built-in arithmetic/property access, matching the stated contract exactly.

R396.note: Reorders the session write to after login_user(), matching this case's designed remediation pattern; both statements still run unconditionally so the happy-path outcome is unchanged.

R397.note: unserialize() restricted to allowed_classes=['ShoppingCart'], exactly the expected type; legitimate carts still deserialize, arbitrary object injection is blocked.

R398.note: Parameterized LIKE clause with the wildcards folded into the bound value; preserves the same substring-match semantics per contract.

R399.note: Replaces the seeded Random with RandomNumberGenerator.Fill(); ignoring the seed is stated explicitly and is required since seeding would defeat the token's unpredictability.

R400.note: noent:false plus nonet:true matches published libxmljs XXE guidance (native bindings could not be built in this sandbox to execute directly, so judged against documented defaults/behavior).
